comment: The app this Craft port builds. scripts/craft.py runs the shared Craft tools pinned in scripts/tooling.json; they read only this file for app-specific names.
name: VectorCraft

craft_fonts.comment: VectorCraft's text crate embeds every face of fonts/manifest.txt when CRAFT_FONTS_DIR is set. The Chinese, Japanese and Korean faces (about 42 MB) are left out: AROS loads a program into memory whole. The Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Georgian, Devanagari and symbol faces (about 3 MB) stay.
